timeline.text: Watch a few of my videos back to back and they blur together — same layout, same colors, same rhythm every time.
Thirty-five different stories ended up looking identical. The problem wasn't the video — it was instructions telling every clip to copy one file.
Now each Remotion clip rolls its own staging: one of eight layouts, a fresh mood, never repeating the last two.
Six new videos went out, and for the first time, every single one actually looks different.
